name: Wang Tile Weave
desc: An aperiodic Wang tiling whose colored edges match across every seam and connect into continuous multi-hue pipes that flow edge-to-edge, the labyrinth slowly scrolling and re-rolling so the pattern perpetually rewrites, rendered as glossy pipe ribbons, neon tubes, copper circuit traces, leaded stained glass, or two-tone op-art.

density.doc: tile fineness — higher packs more, smaller tiles (finer weave)

scale.doc: pipe / ribbon thickness vs design size

flow.doc: strength of the traveling luminance flow sweeping the pipes

hue.doc: base edge-color hue (three families fan out from here)

style.doc: render philosophy — glossy pipe ribbons / neon tubes / copper circuit / stained glass / two-tone op-art

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100=opaque bg; lower leaves trails)
